_comment: Not read by the Lambdas directly — each key here is an environment variable. Copy the relevant section's values into `aws lambda update-function-configuration --environment 'Variables={...}'` (or the console) for the matching function. Every value below is a placeholder; none of it is real.

iam_policy_placeholders._comment: The policies/*.json files are hand-edit templates, not read at runtime. Replace every <TOKEN> before creating the role/policy.
iam_policy_placeholders.<GUEST_GROUP>: the IAM group name spend-guard is allowed to lock, e.g. aws-guests
iam_policy_placeholders.<TOPIC_NAME>: the SNS topic name, e.g. spend-guard-alerts
iam_policy_placeholders.<STATE_PATH_PREFIX>: the SSM parameter path prefix, e.g. aws-guards/spend-guard
iam_policy_placeholders.<INSTANCE_ID>: the one instance gpu-swap is allowed to touch
